p: twenty years: Signifying that he was 20 years in building them.
restored to Solomon: That is, which Hiram gave again to Solomon because they did not please him and therefore called them Cabul, that is, dirt or filth, 1Ki 9:13.
store cities: Meaning of munitions and treasures for the war.
Bethhoron the upper: That is, he repaired and fortified them, for they were built long before by Sherah a noble woman of the tribe of Ephraim, 1Ch 6:68,7:24.
two hundred and fifty: For in all there were 3300 but here he means of them who had the principal charge, 1Ki 9:23.
three times in the year: Read Le 23:1-44.
work of Solomon was prepared unto: Both for the matte and also for the workmanship.
sea side in the land of: Meaning, the Red Sea.
four hundred and fifty talents of: Which is thought to amount to 3,600,000 crowns, for here mention is made of 30 more than are spoken of, 1Ki 9:28.
